title: Gideon and the Echo
author: Bram Vasquez
blurb: Ines Halloran, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, has spent twelve years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the jump window closes.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
